relevant_laws.quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Between a safety zone and the adjacent curb or within 30 feet of points on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a safety zone.
relevant_laws.notes: Fixed safety-zone parking task; official designation and actual placement still require original review.
